cases.instance: selecting a status writes status to the URL
cases.title: Status selection is reflected in the URL
cases.expected: The URL search string contains status=open and /api/tickets is called with status: "open"

cases.instance: selecting a category writes category to the URL
cases.title: Category selection is reflected in the URL
cases.expected: The URL search string contains category=refund_request and /api/tickets is called with category: "refund_request"

cases.instance: typing a search term writes search to the URL
cases.title: Search term is reflected in the URL
cases.expected: The URL search string contains search=login and /api/tickets is called with search: "login"

cases.instance: all three filters set together appear together in the URL
cases.title: Status, category and search coexist in the URL
steps: Select a status, then a category, then type a search term
cases.expected: The URL carries all three params simultaneously and the request carries all three filters

cases.instance: mounting at a URL with all three filter params initialises all three controls
cases.title: Filter controls initialise from the URL
cases.expected: The status select shows 'Open', the category select shows 'Technical', and the search input contains 'login'

cases.instance: mounting at a filtered URL sends those filters to the API
cases.title: Filters from the URL reach /api/tickets on first load
cases.expected: The first /api/tickets call includes status, category and search from the URL — not the defaults

cases.instance: a single-character search term round-trips through the URL
cases.title: One-character search term round-trips
steps: Type a single character 'a' into the search input
cases.expected: search=a appears in the URL and is sent to the API; the input still shows 'a'

cases.instance: a search term containing URL-reserved characters round-trips encoded
cases.title: Reserved characters in the search term survive the URL
steps: Read the URL, then read the search input back
cases.expected: The term is percent-encoded in the URL, decoded back into the input unchanged, and sent to the API as the original string

cases.instance: a search term at maximum practical length round-trips
cases.title: Very long search term does not break the URL
steps: Type a 300-character search term into the search input
cases.expected: The term round-trips through the URL and the page renders; no truncation that changes the sent value silently

cases.instance: typing a search term rapidly leaves the URL matching the final value
cases.title: Fast typing settles on the final search value
cases.expected: The URL ends on search=login and the last request sent carries 'login', not an intermediate prefix

cases.instance: changing status then category before the first request settles keeps both
cases.title: Two filter changes in flight both survive
steps: Mount at /tickets with a slow /api/tickets response
Select a status, then immediately select a category before the first response resolves
cases.expected: The URL carries both params and the settled list reflects both filters

cases.instance: a filtered request that fails leaves the filter in the URL
cases.title: Failed request does not discard the URL filters
cases.expected: ErrorAlert 'Failed to fetch tickets' renders and status=open remains in the URL so the user can correct or retry

cases.instance: clicking a column header writes sortBy and sortOrder to the URL
cases.title: Sorting by a column is reflected in the URL
cases.expected: The URL contains sortBy=subject and sortOrder=asc, and the request carries the same

cases.instance: clicking the same header twice flips sortOrder in the URL
cases.title: Sort direction toggle is reflected in the URL
cases.expected: The URL moves from sortOrder=asc to sortOrder=desc and the request follows

cases.instance: mounting at a sort URL shows the matching sort indicator
cases.title: Sort indicator initialises from the URL
cases.expected: The Subject header shows the ascending arrow; no other header shows a direction arrow

cases.instance: mounting at a sort URL sends that sort to the API
cases.title: Sort from the URL reaches /api/tickets on first load
cases.expected: The first request carries sortBy: "senderName", sortOrder: "asc" instead of the createdAt/desc default

cases.instance: each sortable column round-trips through the URL
cases.title: All five sortable columns round-trip
steps: For each of subject, senderName, status, category, createdAt: mount at /tickets?sortBy=<column>
Read the header indicator and the request params
cases.expected: Every column in core/schemas/tickets.ts sortableColumns is accepted from the URL and sent through

cases.instance: both sort directions round-trip through the URL
cases.title: sortOrder=asc and sortOrder=desc both round-trip
cases.expected: Each mount shows the matching arrow and sends the matching sortOrder

cases.instance: clicking Next writes the page to the URL
cases.title: Advancing a page is reflected in the URL
steps: Mount at /tickets with a total of 50 tickets
cases.expected: The URL contains page=2 and the request carries page: 2

cases.instance: mounting at a page URL requests that page
cases.title: Page initialises from the URL
steps: Mount at /tickets?page=2 with a total of 50 tickets
cases.expected: The first request carries page: 2 and the footer reads 'Page 2 of 5' with 'Showing 11-20 of 50 tickets'

cases.instance: First, Previous and Last each update the URL page
cases.title: All four pagination controls update the URL
steps: Mount at /tickets?page=3 with a total of 50 tickets
Click Previous, then First, then Last
cases.expected: The URL page param tracks each control (2, then absent-or-1, then 5) and each request matches

cases.instance: the last page is reachable from the URL and disables Next
cases.title: Last page from the URL disables forward controls
steps: Mount at /tickets?page=5 with a total of 50 tickets
cases.expected: Next and Last are disabled, Previous and First are enabled, footer reads 'Page 5 of 5'

cases.instance: a page beyond the last page renders without crashing
cases.title: Page past the end degrades gracefully
steps: Mount at /tickets?page=99 with a total of 50 tickets
cases.expected: The page renders (empty body or clamped to the last page) — no crash, no unhandled error, no blank screen

cases.instance: the current page survives a re-render with unchanged filters
cases.title: Page 2 is not reset by a re-render
steps: Force a parent re-render without changing any filter value
cases.expected: The page stays 2 and no page: 1 request is issued — the filters-object identity does not reset pagination

cases.instance: the current page survives a background refetch
cases.title: Page 2 is not reset by a refetch
steps: Trigger a React Query refetch of the tickets query
cases.expected: The refetch requests page 2 and the URL still says page=2

cases.instance: double-clicking Next advances exactly one page
cases.title: Double-click on Next does not skip a page
steps: Mount at /tickets with a total of 50 tickets
cases.expected: The URL lands on page=2, not page=3, and one page-2 request is settled

cases.instance: a paged request that fails leaves the page in the URL
cases.title: Failed request does not discard the URL page
cases.expected: ErrorAlert renders and page=2 stays in the URL

cases.instance: opening a ticket and returning restores the list state
cases.title: List state survives a round trip through a ticket
steps: Apply a status filter, sort by Subject, go to page 2
Open a ticket from the list
cases.expected: The filter, sort and page are all restored exactly as they were left

cases.instance: the list mounts from the URL alone with no in-memory carry-over
cases.title: List state comes from the URL, not component memory
steps: Mount the list at a fully-parameterised URL
Unmount it completely and remount at the same URL
cases.expected: The second mount produces identical controls and an identical request — no state is held outside the URL

cases.instance: the ticket detail back-link returns to the list URL including its params
cases.title: Back-link from ticket detail preserves the list query
steps: Open a ticket from a filtered, sorted, paged list
Use the in-app navigation back to the tickets list
cases.expected: The destination URL carries the same search params the list was left on

cases.instance: reloading the browser on a parameterised list URL restores the same list
cases.title: Full page reload restores the list state
steps: Log in, go to /tickets, apply a filter and go to page 2
cases.expected: The same filter and page are shown after the reload

cases.instance: deep-linking to a parameterised list URL while unauthenticated redirects to login
cases.title: Unauthenticated deep link is still guarded
steps: With no session, navigate directly to /tickets?status=open&page=2
cases.expected: ProtectedRoute redirects to /login; the ticket list is never rendered and no /api/tickets call is made

cases.instance: after logging in from a guarded deep link the list state is restored or explicitly lost
cases.title: List state after login from a deep link
cases.expected: Either the original parameterised URL is restored, or the user lands on the default list — whichever the implementation chooses must be deliberate and consistent, not intermittent

cases.instance: back after a filter change returns to the previous filter state
cases.title: Back undoes a filter change
cases.expected: The list returns to the unfiltered state and the URL loses the status param

cases.instance: back after a page change returns to the previous page
cases.title: Back undoes a page change
steps: Go to /tickets with a total of 50 tickets
cases.expected: The list returns to page 1 and the URL page param follows

cases.instance: forward after back re-applies the state
cases.title: Forward redoes the change Back undid
steps: Apply a filter, press Back, then press Forward
cases.expected: The filter is re-applied and the URL matches the state it had before Back

cases.instance: back through three successive states unwinds them in order
cases.title: Back unwinds a multi-step history in order
steps: Apply a filter, then a sort, then go to page 2
cases.expected: Each Back lands on the immediately preceding list state, ending at the default list

cases.instance: back from the first list state leaves the tickets page rather than trapping the user
cases.title: Back from an untouched list does not trap
steps: Press Back without touching any control
cases.expected: The browser leaves /tickets for the previous page; the user is not held on the list by a replaced history entry

cases.instance: rapid back and forward leaves the rendered list agreeing with the URL
cases.title: Rapid Back/Forward does not desync list and URL
steps: Press Back and Forward rapidly several times
Stop and compare the rendered controls, the rows and the URL
cases.expected: The rendered filter/sort/page controls and the row set all match the final URL

cases.instance: navigating history while a request is in flight does not render the superseded result
cases.title: In-flight request does not overwrite the navigated-to state
steps: Apply a filter with a slow /api/tickets response
Press Back before the response arrives
cases.expected: The settled list matches the URL after the Back, not the superseded in-flight request

cases.instance: changing the status filter while on a later page resets to page 1
cases.title: Status change resets pagination
steps: Mount at /tickets?page=3 with a total of 50 tickets
cases.expected: The request carries page: 1 and the URL no longer says page=3

cases.instance: changing the category filter while on a later page resets to page 1
cases.title: Category change resets pagination
steps: Mount at /tickets?page=3 with a total of 50 tickets
cases.expected: The request carries page: 1 and the URL no longer says page=3

cases.instance: changing the search term while on a later page resets to page 1
cases.title: Search change resets pagination
steps: Mount at /tickets?page=3 with a total of 50 tickets
cases.expected: The request carries page: 1 and the URL no longer says page=3

cases.instance: changing the sort while on a later page resets to page 1
cases.title: Sort change resets pagination
steps: Mount at /tickets?page=3&sortBy=createdAt with a total of 50 tickets
cases.expected: The request carries sortBy: "subject" with page: 1 and the URL reflects both

cases.instance: the pagination reset is visible in the URL and not only in the request
cases.title: Reset to page 1 is reflected in the URL
cases.expected: The URL either drops the page param or sets page=1 — it never keeps a stale page=4 while requesting page 1

cases.instance: clearing a filter while on a later page also resets to page 1
cases.title: Clearing a filter resets pagination
steps: Set the status filter back to 'All statuses'
cases.expected: The request carries page: 1 and the URL drops both status and page

cases.instance: changing a filter while already on page 1 does not add a redundant history entry
cases.title: Reset on page 1 does not pollute history
cases.expected: One Back returns to the unfiltered list — the reset does not push an extra indistinguishable entry

cases.instance: an unsupported status value falls back to no status filter
cases.title: status=frozen falls back
cases.expected: The list renders unfiltered, the status select shows 'All statuses', and no status param is sent to /api/tickets

cases.instance: a real ticket status that agents cannot filter by falls back
cases.title: status=new is rejected client-side
cases.expected: The value is treated as unsupported (it is in ticketStatuses but not agentTicketStatuses) and is not sent — the server would 400 and blank the page

cases.instance: an unsupported category value falls back to no category filter
cases.title: category=billing falls back
cases.expected: The list renders with no category filter and no category param is sent

cases.instance: a rendered but unsortable column falls back to the default sort
cases.title: sortBy=senderEmail falls back to createdAt
cases.expected: The sort falls back to createdAt/desc and sortBy=senderEmail is never sent — it is a rendered column but absent from sortableColumns

cases.instance: an unsupported sort direction falls back to the default direction
cases.title: sortOrder=sideways falls back to desc
cases.expected: sortOrder falls back to desc; sortBy=subject is still honoured

cases.instance: a zero page value falls back to page 1
cases.title: page=0 falls back to page 1
cases.expected: The request carries page: 1 — the server's min(1) constraint is never reached

cases.instance: a negative page value falls back to page 1
cases.title: page=-1 falls back to page 1
cases.expected: The request carries page: 1 and the page renders

cases.instance: a non-numeric page value falls back to page 1
cases.title: page=abc falls back to page 1
cases.expected: The request carries page: 1 — no NaN reaches the query params

cases.instance: a fractional page value falls back to a valid integer page
cases.title: page=1.5 falls back to a valid integer
cases.expected: An integer page is sent; the server's int() constraint is never reached

cases.instance: duplicate values for one param resolve to a single supported value
cases.title: Duplicate status keys resolve to one value
cases.expected: Exactly one supported status is applied and sent; the page does not send a comma-joined or array value the server would reject

cases.instance: an unrecognised query param does not break the page
cases.title: Unknown param is ignored safely
cases.expected: The status filter applies, the unknown param is ignored or preserved harmlessly, and nothing extra is sent to /api/tickets

cases.instance: a malformed query string renders the default list
cases.title: Malformed query string degrades to defaults
cases.expected: The default list renders with default sort and page; no crash and no error alert

cases.instance: every invalid combination still produces a successful API request
cases.title: No URL-supplied value ever reaches the API unvalidated
cases.expected: The request contains only schema-valid values, so ticketListQuerySchema cannot 400 and 'Failed to fetch tickets' is not shown

cases.instance: a page far beyond the result set renders without crashing
cases.title: Very large page value degrades gracefully
steps: Mount at /tickets?page=999999 with a total of 50 tickets
cases.expected: The page renders with an empty body or clamps to the last page; the footer text does not show a nonsensical range

cases.instance: the default list state produces no search params
cases.title: Default list URL is clean
cases.expected: The URL search string stays empty — no sortBy, sortOrder or page appears just because defaults exist

cases.instance: clearing a filter removes its param rather than leaving it empty
cases.title: Cleared status filter drops the param
steps: Set the status filter back to 'All statuses'
cases.expected: The URL drops status entirely — it does not read status= or status=__all__

cases.instance: emptying the search input removes the search param
cases.title: Emptied search input drops the param
cases.expected: The URL drops search entirely and no empty search string is sent to the API

cases.instance: the default sort is absent from the URL
cases.title: Default sort is not written to the URL
steps: Sort by Subject, then sort back to Created descending
cases.expected: Once the state matches the createdAt/desc default, the sort params are absent from the URL

cases.instance: page 1 is absent from the URL
cases.title: Page 1 is not written to the URL
steps: Mount at /tickets with a total of 50 tickets
cases.expected: Back on the first page the URL has no page param rather than page=1

cases.instance: returning every control to its default leaves the URL clean again
cases.title: Full round trip back to defaults empties the URL
steps: Apply a status, a category, a search term, a sort and a page
Return every control to its default
cases.expected: The URL search string is empty again — no residual params from the journey

cases.instance: the default request params are unchanged
cases.title: Default /api/tickets params are byte-identical to today
steps: Mount the tickets list with no URL params
Assert the axios call with an exact params object
cases.expected: axios.get is called with { sortBy: "createdAt", sortOrder: "desc", page: 1, pageSize: 10 } — the existing exact-match test passes unmodified, not loosened to objectContaining

cases.instance: pageSize stays fixed and is not made URL-controllable
cases.title: pageSize is not exposed through the URL
cases.expected: The request still sends pageSize: 10 — page size is out of scope for this story

cases.instance: no new query param is introduced on the API call
cases.title: No additional params are sent to /api/tickets
steps: Exercise every filter, sort and page control
Collect the params of every outgoing request
cases.expected: Every request's params are a subset of the keys ticketListQuerySchema already accepts

cases.instance: the response shape is consumed unchanged
cases.title: Response handling is unchanged
steps: Return the existing { tickets, total, page, pageSize } shape
Read the table body and the pagination footer
cases.expected: Rows, total count and footer text render exactly as before the change

cases.instance: arriving at the list from the nav link produces a defined list state
cases.title: Nav link to Tickets lands on a defined state
steps: Apply a filter and go to page 2 on /tickets
Click the Tickets link in the navigation
cases.expected: The destination is deliberate and repeatable — either the preserved parameterised URL or a clean /tickets. The story does not say which, so whichever is implemented must be consistent and stated; it must not vary by how the nav link is reached

cases.instance: the API contract is unchanged even though the sortable-column list is relocated
cases.title: No API behaviour change from relocating sortableColumns
steps: Inspect the diff for server/** — expect no changes
Compare the sortableColumns values before and after the move to core/constants/ticket-sort.ts
Confirm core/schemas/tickets.ts imports the list rather than redeclaring it
cases.expected: server/** is untouched. ticketListQuerySchema accepts exactly the same five sortBy values as before, so the API contract is unchanged; the only change to core/schemas/tickets.ts is importing the list instead of declaring it inline. There is no server test suite in this repo, so diff inspection plus the value comparison is the control

cases.instance: clicking two different headers before the first request settles leaves the URL on the second
cases.title: Two sort clicks in flight settle on the last one
steps: Mount at /tickets with a slow response
Click the Subject header, then immediately click the Created header
cases.expected: The settled list is sorted by Created and the Subject sort does not win the race. Created descending is the default pair, so AC8 requires the sort params be omitted — the URL therefore empties rather than naming createdAt, and the request that produced the settled rows carries sortBy=createdAt

exploratoryCharters.text: CHARTER: explore the tickets list URL state with hand-edited and shared/bookmarked URLs to discover states the page cannot recover from
CHARTER: explore browser history navigation on the tickets list with rapid back/forward and in-flight requests to discover stale list renders that disagree with the URL
